description: California State Coastal Conservancy: Gravel Beach and Berm for Shorebird Habitat Creation, Erosion Control and Flood Protection is a case study listed in U.S. Climate Resilience Toolkit, a national climate-adaptation toolkit, published or maintained by SCAPE Landscape Architecture; Arcadis; Ducks Unlimited. An adaptive management plan was used in a pilot project to design a 300-foot, nature-based feature. The approach included designing and implementing a monitoring protocol to assess site feasibility and eventually scale the project from a 300-foot feature to a one-mile feature. Coverage: California (2022). The toolkit gives California as the location, 2022 as the year. The listed link gives the documented application. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the toolkit page (no licence or terms statement seen). Caveats: this record was written from the toolkit page, which was read; the cited source documents and the outcomes reported were not checked, and no model or dataset used was verified. It can support comparison with similar adaptation projects and planning precedents. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-us-climate-resilience-toolkit-catalogue.
